posts.zh:
dsh-auto-exit 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。关闭 DSH Web UI 后自动退出 CLI 进程（等效 Ctrl+C），支持可配置宽限期与试运行模式。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e306a37c2d5ba4b51dd1.html
posts.en:
dsh-auto-exit is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Exits the dsh CLI process automatically when the Web UI closes, with a configurable grace period and dry-run mode.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e306a37c2d5ba4b51dd1.html
